predictions:indiana.blurb: Indiana dropped six spots to No. 14 despite sitting fifth in SP+ and eighth in FPI. The metrics think the Hoosiers are being underrated right now.

bubbleNotes:indiana.blurb: Indiana sits at the 14 seed, two spots outside the field, after sliding six places — the sharpest fall among the bubble four.

games:2026-wk13-oklahoma-missouri.blurb: A pick'em in everything but name: Missouri is laying 2.5 at home and ESPN splits it 50.3-49.7. With a 42.5 total, No. 17 Oklahoma and No. 23 Missouri look headed for a low-scoring SEC slugfest with real ranking stakes.

games:2026-wk13-arizona-state-arizona.blurb: No. 16 Arizona hosts Arizona State as an 8.5-point favorite with ESPN giving the Wildcats a 78% shot and a 53.5 total on the board. Arizona is trying to protect a bubble spot; a rivalry stumble would be costly.

games:2026-wk13-nebraska-iowa.blurb: Hank Brown ran for three touchdowns and threw a 9-yard scoring pass to DJ Vonnahme as No. 13 Iowa rolled Nebraska 31-7 in Iowa City. Jamal Rule's 21-yard run was all the Cornhuskers managed, and their two turnovers helped the Hawkeyes pull away with 14 unanswered in the fourth quarter.

games:2026-wk13-washington-oregon.blurb: No. 12 Oregon is a 13.5-point home favorite over No. 24 Washington, with ESPN pegging the Ducks at 87.4%. Oregon is chasing UCLA in the Big Ten race, so style points matter alongside the win.

games:2026-wk13-florida-florida-state.blurb: No. 20 Florida goes to Tallahassee favored by 6.5 in a rivalry game with the highest total on the board at 54.5. The Gators have ranking and momentum to protect against an unranked Florida State.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk13-michigan-ohio-.blurb: No. 21 Ohio State hosts Michigan as a 10.5-point favorite, and ESPN gives the Buckeyes an 89.2% chance. The 37.5 total is the lowest of the week's marquee slate, so points should be at a premium.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk13-louisville-ken.blurb: No. 19 Louisville is only a field-goal favorite at Kentucky despite a 64.4% ESPN win probability, and the 53.5 total suggests both offenses will find room. A loss here would be a serious hit to the Cardinals' resume.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk13-baylor-houston.blurb: No. 18 Houston is a 3.5-point home favorite over Baylor with a 55.5 total, and ESPN gives the Cougars just a 59.6% edge. Close game, high scoring, and Houston's ranking on the line.
